title: 第九章 你给谁变成人了？
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在一周目的时候，亚枫按照系统选项的指示，攻略法厄坦大遗迹，得到了这位龙族之王泽希塔的认可，让人类和龙族缔结了盟约。

泽希塔才两百岁就登上了王座，成为了龙族最年轻的雌龙王，盟约之后，他们也经常进行合作，一来二去，慢慢的也就熟识了，

他也发现，虽然这位龙王傲慢自大没有礼貌，但却相当的讲义气，而且嫉恶如仇，甚至非常有正义感，

那段时期泽希塔带领龙族为他们赢得几场大战的胜利，而亚枫也帮助她解决了龙族叛乱的危机，由此，他得到了泽希塔的信任，与银龙建立了相当深厚的友谊。

而因为系统的缘故，亚枫长期不近女色，慢慢地居然看泽希塔这头雌龙也有点眉清目秀了，

他承认自己有点压抑，但也不能完全怪他，泽希塔作为雌龙体态比一般的龙要更加纤细优美，还通体银白，而且在信任他之后态度也变得温柔了许多，和之前那副目中无人的样子形成了可爱的反差，

一头漂亮的巨龙向你表现出傲娇的模样可真让人无法拒绝。

这种感情在心中不断地发酵，于是亚枫便向她求婚了：

“龙，我喜欢你，是那种跨越物种的喜欢，和我结婚吧，我会对你好的。”

“人，不行，我是龙王，龙王在五百岁之前都不能有伴侣，所以你还得等三百年。”

亚枫的求婚失败了。

在一周目最后时刻，深渊降临，王国和龙族盟军拼死抵抗，最后的关头，他将所有的部队都撤出深渊，留下他和泽希塔断后，在深渊中并肩作战，战至最后一刻，一人一龙力竭瘫倒靠在一起。

临死之际，泽希塔疲惫的看着对他们咆哮的深渊，叹息着对他说道：

“亚枫，如果来世我变成了人，就同意你的求婚，和你结为夫妻吧。”

亚枫睁开眼，最后看了她一眼，虚弱一笑：

“真的？”

“哼，但还是要看你的本事了，能不能再让本王爱上你一次。”泽希塔仰起高大的头颅哼了一声。

“那，你可不能反悔。”

“绝不反悔。”

最后，他和银月龙王一起战死在了深渊之中。

他觉得，自己是真的爱上了这头龙。

所以，二周目，他来履行前世的约定了。

“你放心，这一次不管是两百年还是三百年，我都会等着你的。”亚枫握住了她的手，深情说道。

而泽希塔看着面前的情绪万千的男人，表情逐渐从呆滞，变得惊愕，然后醒悟过来，最后是难以压制的愤怒。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

During the week, Yafeng followed the instructions of the system options and conquered the Phaetan ruins. He got the approval of Zexita, the king of the dragon clan, and allowed humans and dragons to form an alliance.

Zexita ascended the throne when she was only two hundred years old and became the youngest female Dragon King of the Dragon Clan. After the alliance, they often cooperated. After going back and forth, they gradually became familiar with each other.

He also discovered that although the Dragon King was arrogant and rude, he was quite loyal, hated evil, and even had a strong sense of justice.

During that period, Zexita led the Dragon Clan to win several battles for them, and Yafeng also helped her resolve the crisis of the Dragon Clan's rebellion. As a result, he gained Zexita's trust and established a deep friendship with the Silver Dragon.

And because of the system, Yafeng has not been close to women for a long time, but gradually he started to look at Zexita, a female dragon, and she started to look pretty.

He admitted that he was a little depressed, but he couldn't blame him completely. As a female dragon, Zexita's body was more slender and graceful than ordinary dragons, and she was also silver-white. Her attitude became much gentler after trusting him, which formed a lovely contrast with her previous arrogant look.

A beautiful giant dragon showing its arrogance to you is really irresistible.

This feeling kept fermenting in her heart, so Yafeng proposed to her:

"Long, I like you. It's the kind of love that transcends species. Marry me and I will be good to you."

"Human, no, I am the Dragon King. The Dragon King cannot have a partner until he is five hundred years old, so you have to wait three hundred years."

Yafeng's proposal failed.

At the last moment of the first episode, the abyss descended, and the kingdom and dragon allies resisted desperately. At the last moment, he withdrew all his troops from the abyss, leaving him and Zexita to fight side by side in the abyss. Fighting until the last moment, one man and one dragon collapsed together from exhaustion.

On his deathbed, Zechita looked tiredly at the abyss roaring at them, sighed and said to him:

"Yafeng, if I become a human in the next life, I will agree to your proposal and marry you."

Yafeng opened her eyes, took one last look at her, and smiled weakly:

"Really?"

"Hmph, but it still depends on your ability, whether you can make me fall in love with you again." Zexita raised his tall head and snorted.

"Then, you can't go back on your word."

"I will never regret it."

In the end, he and the Silver Moon Dragon King died in the abyss together.

He felt that he really fell in love with this dragon.

So, in the second week, he came to fulfill the agreement in his previous life.

"Don't worry, whether it's two hundred years or three hundred years this time, I will be waiting for you." Ya Feng held her hand and said affectionately.

And Zexita looked at the man in front of him with all kinds of emotions, his expression gradually changed from dullness, to shock, then to awakening, and finally to uncontrollable anger.
